title: Add SDK export compatibility fixtures
summary: The SDK compatibility policy validates package metadata, but source export drift still needs committed fixtures before any stronger SDK compatibility claim can be made.
expectedFailureModes: SDK source exports change silently without a fixture diff.
Compatibility fixtures drift from package metadata and produce false confidence.
Docs confuse workspace export fixtures with public npm semver guarantees.
nextAction: Add committed export fixtures for workspace SDK packages, compare them in the SDK compatibility report, and update docs/status without claiming public SDK stability.
